tools.name: list_compounds
tools.description: Every compound and catalog blend in the library with formula, molecular weight, study count, plus the mechanism and comparison pages.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search compounds (name, aliases, class), mechanisms, comparisons and cited study titles. Returns slugs to pass to get_compound.

tools.name: get_compound
tools.description: Full record for one compound or blend: chemistry (sequence, formula, weight, CAS, PubChem), mechanism as described in the literature with PMIDs, regulator records, evidence counts and every cited study.

tools.name: get_studies
tools.description: Studies cited in the library with PMID, DOI, design and what each measured. Filter by compound, by words in the title, or both.

tools.name: get_regulatory_status
tools.description: FDA, EMA, MHRA and WADA database records for one compound on the check date, with the source of each. Information, not legal advice.

tools.name: compare_compounds
tools.description: Side by side chemistry, class, mechanism statements, regulator records and study counts for two compounds, with the comparison page when one exists.
